title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships (ESKAS)
provider: Swiss Confederation (Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students)
field: All fields (research scholarships and arts scholarships)
description: Scholarships for foreign researchers and artists holding a master's or equivalent to pursue doctoral or postdoctoral research, or an arts degree, at a Swiss public university or recognised institution. Research applicants must secure a Swiss academic supervisor before applying.
amount: Monthly stipend (CHF 1,920 doctoral / CHF 3,500 postdoctoral), housing allowance, health insurance, travel

title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
field: Engineering, natural sciences, mathematics, computer science, management
description: ETH Zurich's most prestigious master's scholarship, for the highest-achieving applicants to a consecutive master's programme, covering study and living costs plus a tuition waiver.
amount: CHF 12,000 per semester towards living and study costs plus a full tuition waiver

title: ETH Zurich Master Scholarship Programme (MSP)
field: Engineering, natural sciences, mathematics, computer science, management
description: Scholarship for academically strong students entering a consecutive master's programme at ETH Zurich, offering a partial living contribution and partial tuition support.
amount: CHF 6,000 per semester towards living costs plus a partial tuition waiver

title: EPFL Excellence Fellowships
field: Engineering, computer and communication sciences, basic sciences, life sciences
description: Merit fellowships for excellent students entering an EPFL master's programme, decided together with admission. Renewal for the second year depends on academic performance.
amount: CHF 16,000 to CHF 32,000 per year towards living expenses

title: University of Geneva Excellence Master Fellowships
field: Science (biology, chemistry, physics, computer science, mathematics, earth sciences, environmental sciences)
description: Fellowships awarded by the Faculty of Science to outstanding students from any country entering a master's programme, based on academic record and motivation.
amount: CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year for the standard duration of the master's

title: Geneva Graduate Institute Scholarships
field: International relations, development studies, international law, international economics, political science
description: Need- and merit-based scholarships for master's and PhD students at the Geneva Graduate Institute, ranging from partial tuition support to full funding including a living stipend.
amount: Partial tuition up to full tuition plus a living stipend (varies by award)
